author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (effect rows stage 0). Partial application: the effect row lives on the LAST arrow of a curried chain, so a partially applied effectful function has the same effectful shape as a plain one. The CL 6494 concrete-parameter check should already reject passing it where a pure function is required (CDX2031); this probe pins that the partial-application path does not slip past it.
